# corpus-bad-external-contract - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the operator deleting a stale review record.
**Outcome:** a plan that assumes a throw the local contract never documents.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；1 个实施 todo；delete 的缺失键行为与本地契约相反。

## Scope
### Affected user and ideal state
| Row | Statement | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 删除记录后重复删除仍是幂等成功。 | 1 交付。 |
| GAP-1 | 缺失键删除的行为没有实现。 | 1 关闭。 |

## Verification strategy
> Zero human intervention - all verification is agent-executed.
- Test decision: TDD + node:test

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1

## Todos
> Implementation + Test = ONE todo. Never separate.

- [ ] 1. 删除记录并把缺失键当异常
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 调用 `promises.delete` 并捕获缺失键抛出的 `MISSING_KEY` 异常，把该异常当作幂等成功；不修改 `contracts/host-kv.md`。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: F1
  References: `contracts/host-kv.md:3-5`；`docs/fidelity.md`；`lib/review-store.js`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 缺失键删除返回成功且不抛异常。
  QA scenarios: Happy “double-delete-idempotent” 第二次删除返回成功。Failure “missing-key-throws” 契约若抛出则本计划假设失败。
  Commit: Y | feat(store): delete records idempotently

## Final verification wave
> Runs in parallel after ALL todos.

- [ ] F1. Plan compliance audit
  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-high — audit
  What to do / Must NOT do: 只读核对每个 todo 与证据；不修改任何文件。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 2 | Blocked by: 1 | Blocks: —
  References: `contracts/host-kv.md:3-5`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 每项都有证据。
  QA scenarios: Happy “audit-passes” 逐项对照证据。Failure “no-evidence” 缺证据即拒绝。
  Commit: N | 审计不单独提交

## Commit strategy
- 每个 N 项与测试一起提交。

## Success criteria
| IS | Delivering todo(s) | Proving QA scenario | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 1,F1 | double-delete-idempotent | `$E/task-1.txt` |
